import csv,gzip,io,math
from urllib.request import Request,urlopen
from openpyxl import load_workbook
import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import linear_sum_assignment

expr_path='/jetstream2/scratch/main/jobs/79036638/inputs/dataset_2dd44a7e-8ce3-4b19-92f0-bba8a12200e9.dat'
with open(expr_path,'rb') as fh:
    magic=fh.read(2)
opener=gzip.open if magic==b'\x1f\x8b' else open
genes=[]
rows=[]
with opener(expr_path,'rt',newline='') as fh:
    rd=csv.reader(fh,delimiter='\t')
    header=next(rd)
    labels=header[1:]
    for r in rd:
        if not r: continue
        genes.append(r[0])
        rows.append([float(x) for x in r[1:]])
X=np.asarray(rows,dtype=float)
logX=np.log1p(X)
mu=logX.mean(axis=1,keepdims=True)
sd=logX.std(axis=1,keepdims=True)
Z=np.divide(logX-mu,sd,out=np.zeros_like(logX),where=sd>0)
gene_to_i={g:i for i,g in enumerate(genes)}

url='https://ars.els-cdn.com/content/image/1-s2.0-S2211124725000117-mmc5.xlsx'
req=Request(url,headers={'User-Agent':'Mozilla/5.0','Referer':'https://www.cell.com/'})
open('mmc5.xlsx','wb').write(urlopen(req,timeout=90).read())
wb=load_workbook('mmc5.xlsx',read_only=True,data_only=True)
ws=wb['Table S4']
it=ws.iter_rows(values_only=True)
h=list(next(it))
ix={str(v):i for i,v in enumerate(h)}
by_cluster={i:[] for i in range(15)}
for r in it:
    try:
        g=str(r[ix['Gene_ID']])
        fc=float(r[ix['avg_log2FC']])
        padj=float(r[ix['p_val_adj']])
        c=int(r[ix['cluster']])
    except Exception:
        continue
    if c in by_cluster and padj<0.05 and fc>0.25 and g in gene_to_i:
        by_cluster[c].append((g,fc))
for c in by_cluster:
    by_cluster[c].sort(key=lambda t:(-t[1],t[0]))

groups={
 'cortex':[2],
 'endodermis':[9],
 'epidermis':[1,5,7],
 'meristems':[0,3,12],
 'pericycle':[6],
 'phloem':[11,13],
 'provascular':[4],
 'root_cap':[14],
 'root_hair':[8],
 'xylem':[10],
}
types=list(groups)
depths=[20,50,100,200,500]
score_by_depth={}
assignments={}
swap_by_depth={}
for depth in depths:
    S=np.zeros((len(types),len(labels)))
    marker_counts={}
    for ti,t in enumerate(types):
        best={}
        for c in groups[t]:
            for g,fc in by_cluster[c]:
                if g not in best or fc>best[g]: best[g]=fc
        selected=sorted(best,key=lambda g:(-best[g],g))[:depth]
        marker_counts[t]=len(selected)
        ids=[gene_to_i[g] for g in selected]
        S[ti,:]=Z[ids,:].mean(axis=0) if ids else np.nan
    score_by_depth[depth]=S
    rr,cc=linear_sum_assignment(-S)
    pred={labels[j]:types[i] for i,j in zip(rr,cc)}
    assignments[depth]=pred
    base=sum(S[types.index(l),labels.index(l)] for l in labels)
    best_pair=None; best_score=base
    for a in range(len(labels)):
      for b in range(a+1,len(labels)):
        sc=base
        sc-=S[types.index(labels[a]),a]+S[types.index(labels[b]),b]
        sc+=S[types.index(labels[b]),a]+S[types.index(labels[a]),b]
        if sc>best_score:
          best_score=sc; best_pair=(labels[a],labels[b])
    swap_by_depth[depth]=(best_pair,best_score-base)

# consensus: standardize each row within a depth then average
Cs=[]
for depth,S in score_by_depth.items():
    sm=S.mean(axis=1,keepdims=True); ss=S.std(axis=1,keepdims=True)
    Cs.append((S-sm)/np.where(ss==0,1,ss))
C=np.mean(Cs,axis=0)
rr,cc=linear_sum_assignment(-C)
cons={labels[j]:types[i] for i,j in zip(rr,cc)}
base=sum(C[types.index(l),labels.index(l)] for l in labels)
pairs=[]
for a in range(len(labels)):
  for b in range(a+1,len(labels)):
    sc=base-C[types.index(labels[a]),a]-C[types.index(labels[b]),b]+C[types.index(labels[b]),a]+C[types.index(labels[a]),b]
    pairs.append((sc-base,labels[a],labels[b]))
pairs.sort(reverse=True)

with open('swap_diagnostics.txt','w') as out:
    out.write(f'MATRIX\tgenes={len(genes)}\tcolumns={len(labels)}\tlabels={",".join(labels)}\n')
    out.write('CLUSTER_DEG_COUNTS\t'+'\t'.join(f'{c}:{len(by_cluster[c])}' for c in range(15))+'\n')
    for depth in depths:
        out.write(f'DEPTH\t{depth}\tBEST_SWAP\t{swap_by_depth[depth][0]}\tGAIN\t{swap_by_depth[depth][1]:.6f}\n')
        out.write('ASSIGNMENT\t'+';'.join(f'{lab}->{assignments[depth][lab]}' for lab in labels)+'\n')
    out.write('CONSENSUS_ASSIGNMENT\t'+';'.join(f'{lab}->{cons[lab]}' for lab in labels)+'\n')
    out.write('TOP_TRANSPOSITIONS\n')
    for gain,a,b in pairs[:8]:
        out.write(f'{a},{b}\t{gain:.6f}\n')
    out.write('CONSENSUS_SCORE_MATRIX\n')
    out.write('reference\observed\t'+'\t'.join(labels)+'\n')
    for i,t in enumerate(types):
        out.write(t+'\t'+'\t'.join(f'{v:.3f}' for v in C[i])+'\n')
